name: RÄƑZBOI
description: RÄƒzboi (Romanian for 'War') is a classic, high-energy card game of chance played primarily by children and families in Romania. While globally known as 'War', the Romanian variant features specific point-values for face cards (often treated as 10s) and a unique 'Escalation' rule for ties, where the number of cards laid down during a conflict depends on the rank of the card that triggered the war. It is a game of pure persistence and endurance.

Part of the ancient 'Battle' family of card games that appeared in Europe in the 17th century. The Romanian version, RÄƒzboi, has been a cultural staple in schools and villages for generations.
Standard 52-card French deck; Ace ranks high. The deck is divided evenly among the players. Suits are ignored; only rank matters for battles and wars.
